description: This file contains SASS mixins related to Font Awesome icons, border-radius styling, and icon stacking layout.
external_files: The font-family specified in icon-FontAwesome mixin

methods.name: icon
methods.description: Mixin to display an icon using Font Awesome, setting content to the icon variable and including font styles.

methods.name: icon-FontAwesome
methods.description: Mixin to set font-family and font-related properties for Font Awesome icons.

methods.name: border-radius
methods.description: Mixin to apply border-radius with vendor prefixes to an element.

methods.name: icon-stack
methods.description: Mixin to define a stacked icon layout with customizable width, height, and font sizes.
